translation: In the conditions of injury, pain from injury to the bone is a light injury. If the injury is heavy, then the bone is either broken or shattered, and one must use manual methods to regulate and treat it; those methods have already been set out in detail in the preceding section. This is a slight injury from knocking and bumping, with pain among the bones and no change in the color of the flesh; one should externally use the Scallion Ironing Method (蔥熨法), and internally take Myrrh Pill (沒藥丸); during the day take the Rehmannia Pill (地黃丸), and it will heal of itself.
